usage: The SQLite contention probe is a path/process-scanning repository tool whose steps must exchange repository paths, worker modes, and worker arguments as strings. The benchmark harness also has a typed process-boundary environment adapter, and the compiler behavior test intentionally groups independent PHPUnit cases. The rules disabled for those narrow paths add no actionable signal; critical rules stay enforced elsewhere.

rule_sets.matching_content_path_doc: This behavior test groups independent compiler contract cases so their exact SQL assertions remain in one focused fixture.
The harness environment adapter receives typed process metadata as an array to avoid reintroducing a benchmark-only request object.
